title: Robot Oracle with Planets
description: A steampunk robot with multiple mechanical arms stands on a circular platform covered in runes, juggling five glowing celestial orbs representing planets. At its base, a silhouetted figure reaches upward from a pile of dark earth containing scattered golden keys and symbols, with decorative banners hanging above.
prompt: A detailed surreal steampunk robot with multiple flexible mechanical arms and glowing blue eyes stands on a rune-covered circular platform, juggling five glowing orbs representing the planets: a purple Saturn-like orb, a teal swirling orb, a red Mars-like orb, a golden orb, and a pink orb. The robot has a frilly skirt base with many tentacle-like wires extending down. At the bottom, a black silhouette of a woman reaches up from a pile of dark earth mixed with golden keys and occult symbols. Decorative banners with text hang above against a light background with paint splatters.
